sentences.en: We will replace the current version with the upgrade.
sentences.zh: 我们将用新版本替换当前版本。

sentences.en: These fancy upgrades only serve to snailify the car.
sentences.zh: 这些花哨的改进只会让汽车变得迟缓。

sentences.en: In the future, Firefox will upgrade plugins for you.
sentences.zh: 未来，Firefox 将会自动为你更新插件。
